name: Instagram Hashtags
introduction: Compare engagement on similar Instagram posts — same format and subject — where some captions include hashtags and others do not. The goal is to see whether tags change likes, views, or other interaction metrics.
results: Six beer-review posts with hashtags vs two without. Averages are close: with-hashtags ~26 likes / 201 views, without ~28 likes / 192 views. The without-hashtags arm is still thin, and newer posts have had less time to accumulate reach, so treat this as directional rather than conclusive.
